NAL = never reached +2, stopped (DUSK type). Way 2: EPIC from the path-based A2_reach (moments.csv) agrees with peak_all on 100 % of fills.

## 5. ENTRY FILTER test — "refuse when zone" (per SIGNAL, skips = 0)

Survivors = family-wise p ≤ 0.05 on S in K1, K2 or K3. Also shown, LABELLED NOT SURVIVORS: the next 3 K3 tests by S and the K3 tick-only top. Δ = −Σ zone pct / N_all (RM = resting-TP ruler; LS = RM − 0.20 on STOP / CAP). Expectancy bar on the refused cohort, per year: WR < breakeven · P(avg < 0) ≥ 0.95 day-bootstrap · ≥ 8 days · no day / pair ≥ 50 % of the cohort loss · N ≥ 15.
